key_decisions.rationale: Keeps all three political charges and their reported nature.

key_decisions.after: Pilate asked him, “Are you the king of the Jews?” Jesus answered, “You say so.”

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves authority transfer, both rulers, location, and timing.

key_decisions.after: Learning that Jesus was under Herod’s jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who was also in Jerusalem during those days.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps Herod’s prolonged curiosity, report, and spectacle motive.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps exact timing and ironic reconciliation.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps accusation, public examination, and innocence finding.
